topic: Volume and Measuring Volume of Matter
key_concepts: Volume is the amount of space something takes up.
Liquids, solids, and gases such as air have volume.
Common tools for measuring volume include beakers, graduated cylinders, measuring cups, me
Common units of volume include milliliters and liters.
Milliliter is a small unit of volume abbreviated mL.
Liter is a larger unit of volume abbreviated L.
Milliliters are used for small amounts and liters for larger amounts.
Liquid volume in a graduated cylinder is read at the meniscus.
Adding more liquid or objects to a container increases the occupied volume.
The volume of an irregular solid like a stone can be measured by water displacement.
